object.attr: derived: CF-V3 (D-V1), review Q23. Mellon can't sign, and a server that requires signatures refuses the push later, far from its cause; re-signing by rebase rewrites the commits that acknowledged commits name. Covers commit.gpgsign and tag.gpgSign. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V2), to confirm.
object.description: If git's settings ask to sign a commit or tag that Mellon is about to make, Mellon shall refuse to make the commit or tag and say that Mellon can't sign.
